'''Feddasyr''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Elus sector/Legends|Elus sector]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. The planet was known for being a drug and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hub. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the planet had a neutral status.

[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Sarin (rebel agent)|Sarin]] operated undercover for 5 years on Feddasyr without her cover ever being blown.
